description: Permutation null test for whether the LONRF1 RING1-RING2 arrangement matches an active RING E3 dimer
code:
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, os
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
rng=np.random.default_rng(20251124)
def parse_pdb(t):
    at=[]
    for ln in t.splitlines():
        if ln.startswith("ENDMDL"): break
        if ln.startswith(("ATOM","HETATM")) and ln[16] in (" ","A"):
            at.append(dict(name=ln[12:16].strip(),resn=ln[17:20].strip(),ch=ln[21],resi=int(ln[22:26]),
                xyz=np.array([float(ln[30:38]),float(ln[38:46]),float(ln[46:54])])))
    return at
def rcsb(p): return parse_pdb(requests.get(f"https://files.rcsb.org/download/{p}.pdb",timeout=150).text)
def af(a):
    u=[e for e in requests.get(f"https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/api/prediction/{a}",timeout=90).json() if e["entryId"]==f"AF-{a}-F1"][0]["pdbUrl"]
    return parse_pdb(requests.get(u,timeout=200).text)
def idx(at):
    d={}
    for a in at: d[(a["ch"],a["resi"],a["name"])]=a["xyz"]
    return d
def coords(d,ch,res): return np.array([x for r in res for x in (d[(ch,r,"CA")], d.get((ch,r,"CB"),d[(ch,r,"CA")]))])
def kabsch(P,Q):
    Pm,Qm=P.mean(0),Q.mean(0); Pc,Qc=P-Pm,Q-Qm
    V,S,Wt=np.linalg.svd(Pc.T@Qc); R=V@np.diag([1,1,np.sign(np.linalg.det(V@Wt))])@Wt
    return float(np.sqrt((((Pc@R)-Qc)**2).sum()/len(P)))
def randrot():
    q=rng.normal(size=4); q/=np.linalg.norm(q); w,x,y,z=q
    return np.array([[1-2*(y*y+z*z),2*(x*y-z*w),2*(x*z+y*w)],
                     [2*(x*y+z*w),1-2*(x*x+z*z),2*(y*z-x*w)],
                     [2*(x*z-y*w),2*(y*z+x*w),1-2*(x*x+y*y)]])

A=idx(rcsb("4AP4")); L1=idx(af("Q17RB8"))
RNF4_p1=[136,139,158,160,163,166,177,180]; RNF4_p2=[201,204,223,225,228,231,242,245]
R1=[123,126,138,140,143,146,155,158]; R2=[479,482,494,496,499,502,513,516]
ref=np.vstack([coords(A,"A",RNF4_p1),coords(A,"A",RNF4_p2)])
P1,P2=coords(L1,"A",R1),coords(L1,"A",R2)
obs=kabsch(np.vstack([P1,P2]),ref)

# NULL: keep RING1 fixed, keep the observed 21.2 A centroid separation, randomise RING2 orientation AND direction
c1,c2=P1.mean(0),P2.mean(0); sep=np.linalg.norm(c2-c1)
null=[]
for _ in range(4000):
    R=randrot(); d=rng.normal(size=3); d/=np.linalg.norm(d)
    P2r=(P2-c2)@R + c1 + d*sep
    null.append(kabsch(np.vstack([P1,P2r]),ref))
null=np.array(null); p=float((null<=obs).mean())
print(f"Observed RMSD of LONRF1 RING1+RING2 onto the RNF4 RING dimer : {obs:.2f} A")
print(f"Null (4000 random rigid placements of RING2 at the same 21.2 A separation):")
print(f"   median {np.median(null):.2f} A, 1st percentile {np.percentile(null,1):.2f} A, min {null.min():.2f} A")
print(f"   empirical p(null <= observed) = {p:.4f}")

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(6.5,4))
ax.hist(null,bins=60,color="#bbb",edgecolor="none",label="random RING2 placement (n=4000)")
ax.axvline(obs,color="#c44e52",lw=2.5,label=f"AlphaFold LONRF1 RING1+RING2\n({obs:.2f} A, p={p:.4f})")
ax.set_xlabel("RMSD to the RNF4 RING-dimer arrangement (A, 32 zinc-ligand anchors)")
ax.set_ylabel("count"); ax.legend(fontsize=8); ax.set_title("The two LONRF1 RINGs sit in an E3-dimer-like arrangement",fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()

os.makedirs("artifacts",exist_ok=True)
print("\ncwd:",os.getcwd(),"| files:",os.listdir("."))
